info.description: Container management API. Authenticate with `POST /auth/login`; the session cookie authenticates later calls, and every call that is not GET must also send the `csrf_token` from the login response in the `x-csrf-token` header.

101.description: Switching protocols. Text frames are `ClientMsg` from the client and `ServerMsg` from the server; exec I/O uses binary frames `[u32 sub id, big-endian][bytes]`.

access.description: kube-agent: the access level its manifest grants.

custom_resources.description: kube-agent: the manifest also reads every kind, for custom resources.

ApiKind.description: A kind the cluster serves that FleetOps has no curated page for.

columns.description: CRD printer columns (priority 0, Age dropped); empty for others.

crd.description: The CRD's name, when one defines it.

force.description: Take ownership of fields another manager owns.

namespace.description: For namespaced documents that name none.

code.description:
An `ErrorBody` code: `conflict` for a field-manager conflict,
`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not_found`, `upstream`…

ApplyResult.description: What happened to one document of an apply or edit.

after.description: The object as written (or as it would be, for a dry run).

before.description: The live object before the write, cleaned and masked; `None` when created.

index.description: Position among the submitted non-empty documents, from 0.

force.description: Disconnect only: detach even if the container is running.

setup_open.description: `POST /auth/setup` is still accepted (the setup window has not closed).

BuildForm.description:
Multipart body of `POST /envs/{env}/images/build`: send `context` or
`dockerfile`, not both.

context.description: A tar of the build context.

dockerfile.description: A lone Dockerfile, when there is no other context.

tag.description: Tag for the built image, e.g. `app:1.2`.

CallerAccess.description:
The caller's grants on one environment, for the UI to offer only what
they allow. A hint: the server checks every request.

namespaces.description: Every namespace any grant covers; null when one covers the whole environment.

role.description:
The strongest built-in role among the grants (custom roles count as
their closest built-in).

role_name.description: The custom role's name, when exactly one grant is a custom role.

ChartRef.description: Where a chart comes from (spec 3j §5): a repository and chart name, or an OCI reference.

ChartShow.description: A chart's metadata and default values, for the editor.

oneOf.description: Exec stdin as text, for clients that cannot send binary frames.

ClientMsg.description:
A text frame from the client. Exec stdin may also arrive as a binary
frame of `[u32 sub id, big-endian][bytes]`.

errors.description: `name: error` for each container it failed on.

ContainerSpec.description:
Everything the create/recreate form edits. `advanced` is a Docker API
`ContainerCreate` JSON object merged over the generated body.

state.description: created | running | paused | restarting | exited | removing | dead

volumes.description: Names of named volumes mounted by this container.

start.description: Start the container after creating it (default true).

oneOf.description: kube-agent: what the agent's ClusterRole allows; default `standard`.

context.description: kube-config: the context to use; default the current one.

custom_resources.description: kube-agent: also read every kind, for custom resources; off by default.

kubeconfig.description: kube-config: the kubeconfig, stored encrypted and never returned.

skip_check.description: kube-config: save without checking that the cluster answers.

url.description: The Docker URL of a local environment; other kinds take none.

CreatedEnv.description: A newly created environment; an agent one carries its enrollment once.

truncated.description: True when the listing hit the size/entry cap and is incomplete.

Discovery.description: Every generic kind, and the API groups that could not be read.

DockerEvent.description: One Docker event, reduced to what the UI needs to patch its caches.

name.description: The actor's `name` attribute when Docker sends one.

EditableObject.description: An object as the YAML editor opens it.

resource_version.description: Sent back with the edit; a newer version on the server is a conflict.

yaml.description:
`managedFields`, `status` and the last-applied annotation removed;
Secret values masked.

EditionInfo.description: `GET /edition`: the edition and the features in effect right now.

join_token.description: Shown once. Valid for 15 minutes and for one agent.

EnvVersion.description: What an up environment reports about itself.

oneOf.description: The caller's access here (admins: everything on the whole environment).
What may be shown of a stored kubeconfig (kube-config environments).

EnvView.description: An environment as listed: agent environments carry their agent's state.

ErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every error response.

request_id.description: Matches the `x-request-id` response header and the server log.

cmd.description: `None` auto-detects a shell (bash, falling back to sh).

container.description:
Kubernetes only: the container; `None` is the pod's first. Docker
ignores it.

Feature.description: An Enterprise feature a license can grant.

GrantView.description: One grant: where it applies and what it allows.

install.description: Whether install and upgrade are available (the server has --helm-binary).

HelmObjectChange.description: What a rollback or uninstall does (or did) to one object.

after.description: The object after (or as it would be); `None` for a delete or keep.

before.description: The live object before, cleaned and masked; `None` when absent.

HelmPlan.description: A rollback, uninstall, install or upgrade: the dry run's plan, or a commit's results.

current.description:
The latest revision this was computed against; a commit sends it
back as `expected_current`.

hooks.description: Install and upgrade: the hooks that run, in order.

revision.description: Commit of a rollback only: the revision written.

status.description:
Commit only: the release's status afterwards (`deployed`, `failed`
or `uninstalled`).

values_after.description: Install and upgrade: the new values, masked YAML.

values_before.description: Upgrade: the current values, masked YAML.

HelmRelease.description: One release, at its latest revision.

error.description: Why the record cannot be read, when the status is `unreadable`.

updated.description: Last deployed, unix seconds; 0 when unknown.

HelmRevision.description: One revision in a release's history.

HookStep.description: One hook a deploy runs, as the plan lists it.

removed.description: Image ids deleted and tags removed, as Docker reports them.

expected_current.description: The plan's `current`; 0 for a new release.

KindRef.description:
A served resource, the key of every generic request: `group` is empty
for the core API.

KubeAccess.description: What the in-cluster agent's ClusterRole allows (spec §2.5).

KubeCount.description: How many objects of one kind there are, or why that is unknown.

KubeFilter.description:
A server-side narrowing of a list or watch (spec 3e §4). Only Events
have one: their warnings, the rows an overview shows.

containers.description:
Pods: container names, first is the default. Workloads with pod
logs: the pod template's.

KubeRef.description:
An owner, e.g. a Pod's ReplicaSet. `link` is set when FleetOps has a
page for the owner's kind.

KubeRow.description: One object in a list: common fields plus columns that depend on its kind.

columns.description: Kind-specific: ready, restarts, node, type, ports, hosts…

KubeUsage.description:
Usage of one kind (nodes or pods). `available` is false when the
cluster has no metrics API, which is common and not an error.

reason.description: Why there are no metrics, when `available` is false.

KubeUsageRow.description: Live CPU and memory of one node or pod, from metrics-server.

cpu.description: Millicores in use; a pod's is the sum of its containers.

cpu_allocatable.description: Nodes only: allocatable millicores, when the node is visible.

nodes.description: `None` when the credentials may not list nodes.

KubeconfigSummary.description: What may be shown about a stored kubeconfig.

exec_command.description: Exec users only: the plugin's command name, never its arguments.

pod.description: Kubernetes merged logs only: the pod the line came from.

text.description:
One line without its trailing newline. With `timestamps`, Docker's
RFC 3339 timestamp and a space come first.

container.description:
Kubernetes only: the container; `None` is the pod's first. Docker
ignores it.

previous.description:
Kubernetes only: the container's previous (terminated) run. Never
follows. Docker ignores it.

tail.description: Lines from the end to start with; `None` means the whole log.

host_port.description: None publishes on a random host port.

PrinterColumn.description: One column `kubectl get` shows for a custom resource.

oneOf.description: Where FleetOps last installed or upgraded the chart from (spec 3j §5).

hidden.description:
Values and notes were left out: the caller's role lacks Reveal on
Helm releases.

manifest.description: The rendered manifest, Secret values masked.

values.description: User-supplied values as YAML, credential-looking keys masked; empty when none.

expected_current.description: The latest revision the plan was reviewed against.

SecretValue.description: One key of a Secret, for a role with Reveal on Secrets.

value.description: The value as text, or base64 when it is not UTF-8.

oneOf.description:
A payload for subscription `sub`: a `DockerEvent`, a `StatsSample`,
an array of `LogLine`s, a task progress message, or a `WatchEvent`
(kube-watch).
The logs queue overflowed and `dropped` lines were skipped.

The subscription is over. `reason` is `closed`, `ended`, `eof`,
`exited` (with `exit_code`), `succeeded` or `failed` (with `task`),
`error` (kube-watch, with `message`), or `access` (the user's access
changed, with `message`).

A request failed; `sub` is null when the frame named no valid
subscription. `code` is an error code as in `ErrorBody`.
An environment went up or down.
The user's access changed: what they can see may differ.

ServerMsg.description:
A text frame from the server, as the builders below write it. Exec
output arrives as binary frames of `[u32 sub id, big-endian][bytes]`.
Documentation only: `tests/openapi.rs` checks each builder against it.

namespaces.description: Kubernetes only; omit for the whole environment.

StatsSample.description:
One stats sample for a container, with CPU already turned into a
percentage of one core times the number of cores (as `docker stats`).

target.description: What the task works on, e.g. the image reference.

task_id.description: Subscribe to it with the websocket `task` topic or poll `GET /tasks/{id}`.

expected_current.description: The latest revision the plan was reviewed against.

values.description: YAML; masked values sent back unchanged keep their stored value.

oneOf.description: Every row, replacing what the client holds.
The upstream watch restarted; a `Snapshot` follows.

WatchEvent.description:
One change to a watched list. A watch that fails for good ends its
stream with `Err` instead.

tags.name: websocket
tags.description: Real-time events, stats, logs and exec
